name: location-report
title: Location review report
for_each: select id,code from locations order by code

sections.title: All imported ratings
sections.sql: select external_id as review,platform,rating,reviewed_on,disposition,owner from v_reviews where location_id=$1 order by reviewed_on,external_id
sections.note: Every imported review is included regardless of rating or response decision. This report is an internal snapshot.

sections.title: Open service actions
sections.sql: select a.title,a.owner,a.due_on,a.evidence from actions a join reviews r on r.id=a.review_id where r.location_id=$1 and a.status='open' order by a.due_on

name: response-record
title: Review response evidence
for_each: select id,external_id from reviews order by id

sections.title: Response decision
sections.sql: select owner,disposition,coalesce(nullif(disposition_reason,''),'No closing decision') disposition_reason,coalesce(nullif(source_reply,''),'None in current export') source_reply,coalesce(reply,'Not drafted') reply,coalesce(reply_author,'Not recorded') reply_author,coalesce(approved_by,'Not approved') approved_by,coalesce(posted_at::text,'Not recorded') posted_at,coalesce(posted_url,'Not recorded') posted_url from v_reviews where id=$1
sections.note: Source replies and locally approved replies are separate. A posting record is an operator assertion, not a platform receipt.

sections.title: Integrity assessment
sections.sql: select coalesce(finding,'Not assessed') finding,coalesce(relationship,'Not assessed') relationship,coalesce(incentive,'Not assessed') incentive,coalesce(assessment_evidence,'No evidence recorded') assessment_evidence from v_reviews where id=$1

sections.title: Decision history
sections.sql: select actor,action,created_at from events where review_id=$1 order by created_at,id
